about-lion: Here is the lion, king of the grassland! Listen to his big, deep voice.
about-elephant: Say hello to the elephant! She has a long trunk and big, flappy ears.
about-giraffe: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all. Her long neck reaches up to the treetops!
about-zebra: Stripes, stripes, stripes! This is the zebra, and no two zebras have the same stripes.
about-monkey: The monkey loves to climb and swing from tree to tree. Can you hear him chatter?
about-owl: Shh, it is the owl! She has big round eyes that can see in the dark.
about-tiger: Here comes the tiger! His orange and black stripes help him hide in the tall grass.
about-bear: Meet the bear! He is big and cuddly, and he loves to eat honey.
about-frog: Splash! The frog sits by the pond, ready to take a great big hop.
about-hippo: The hippo has a very big mouth, and she loves a long, cool bath.
about-panda: The panda munches bamboo all day long. Crunch, crunch, crunch!
about-penguin: The penguin cannot fly, but she can swim fast and slide on her tummy!
about-fox: The fox is clever, with pointy ears and a fluffy tail.
about-deer: The deer tiptoes through the forest on long, slim legs.
about-rabbit: Hop, hop, hop! The rabbit has long ears and a tiny twitchy nose.
about-cow: The cow gives us fresh milk. Can you hear her say moo?
about-koala: The koala is soft and sleepy. She hugs a tree and munches on leaves.
about-sheep: Baa, baa! The sheep has a fluffy woolly coat that keeps her warm.
about-pig: Oink, oink! The pig has a curly tail, and she loves to roll in the mud.
about-turtle: The sea turtle paddles through the water with her big, strong flippers.
about-dolphin: The dolphin is clever and playful. Watch her leap out of the waves!
about-octopus: The octopus has eight wiggly arms. Can you count them with me?
about-whale: The whale is the biggest animal in the sea. She sings a deep, slow song.
about-jellyfish: The jellyfish floats like a soft umbrella. She drifts gently, up and down.
about-crab: Click, click! The crab walks sideways on the sand and waves his claws.
about-starfish: The starfish has five arms. Let us count them: one, two, three, four, five!
ic-intro: Welcome to the ice cream shop!
ic-top-cherry: and a cherry on top, please!
ic-top-wafer: and a wafer on top, please!
